headline: White House diesel export ban talk whipsaws fuel markets
intro: Diesel traders can't catch a breath — one day it's a potential export ban crashing futures, the next it's the White House denying everything and the rally resuming. Meanwhile retail diesel just keeps notching records, and Washington's debate over restricting exports is now reshaping gasoline and jet fuel math too.
overview: Diesel remains the epicenter of US fuels markets: ULSD spot sits above $5/gal with a crack near $114/bbl, and speculation over a possible export ban has sent futures swinging violently — down 6% on the report, then back up nearly 12 cents on denial — while sending European diesel prices surging in sympathy. Retail diesel hit fresh records (Alabama, national averages near $6.53), squeezing farmers and truckers and becoming a political liability ahead of midterms, even as analysts warn that shifting refinery yield toward diesel could flip the US into a gasoline importer next quarter. Elsewhere, SAF and renewable diesel investment continued apace with new Google/Bain-backed eSAF offtake for Infinium's Texas project and Uniper's long-term eSAF purchase from Arcadia.

stories.title: Diesel Rally Resumes Amid Growing Debate Over US Export Limits
stories.summary: October ULSD futures jumped nearly 12 cents Thursday, reversing most of Wednesday's selloff, as debate continues over the merits and likelihood of US diesel export restrictions.

stories.title: Diesel Futures Drop 6% on Export Ban Report White House Denied
stories.summary: A report of a possible US diesel export ban crashed ULSD futures 6% before a White House denial; diesel stocks remain 13% below seasonal average.

stories.title: Export ban talk sinks diesel, boosts gasoline as White House eyes options
stories.summary: Export ban talk sank diesel while boosting gasoline futures; analysts say even a 3% yield shift from diesel to gasoline could make the US a net gasoline importer in Q4 2026.

stories.title: A Diesel Export Ban Could Lower Diesel Prices But Raise Other Costs
stories.summary: A US diesel export ban could lower domestic diesel prices but raise food costs, pressure refiners, and tighten gasoline and jet fuel supplies.

stories.title: Trump Fuel Export Ban Threat Sends European Diesel Soaring
stories.summary: Trump's push to ban American diesel exports sent European diesel prices surging.

stories.title: Oil Rises as Diesel Export Talk Swirls
stories.summary: Brent rose nearly 4% as tight fuel supplies, Hormuz risks, and diesel export concerns drove trading.

stories.title: Skyrocketing diesel prices rattle Republicans as midterms approach
stories.summary: Record diesel prices amid intensifying Middle East conflict are becoming a political liability for Republicans ahead of midterms, hitting farmers and rural residents hardest.

stories.title: Diesel Hits Record Even As Oil Prices Fall
stories.summary: Diesel hit a record $6.53/gal even as benchmark crude fell to a two-week low, with the national average at $6.52.

stories.title: Alabama diesel prices hit new record high
stories.summary: Alabama diesel prices set a new state record high, according to AAA, as regular gasoline climbs toward its 2022 record.

stories.title: Gas Prices 23 Cents Higher This Week
stories.summary: Iowa gasoline prices rose 23 cents in a week to a statewide average of $4.34/gal, per AAA's weekly fuel report.

stories.title: Economist: expanding E15 could help ease pressure on diesel prices
stories.summary: An Illinois ag economist argues expanding E15 consumption could indirectly ease pressure on diesel prices by closing the gap with gasoline demand.

stories.title: Google, others back Infinium's 100,000-tpy eSAF project in Texas
stories.summary: Google and Bain & Company are among SABA members backing Infinium's 100,000-tpy eSAF project in Texas with long-term SAF certificate purchase commitments.

stories.title: Uniper signs 40,000-t/y eSAF off-take deal with Arcadia
stories.summary: Uniper signed a legally binding deal to purchase 40,000 t/y of eSAF from Arcadia eFuels' planned Project Endor for over a decade.

stories.title: Fuel refining stocks gain from widening gasoline-crude spread
stories.summary: Fuel refining stocks and ETFs are gaining as refinery disruptions widen gasoline-crude spreads, boosting margins but raising prices for consumers.
